experiment_data.hypothesis: Cheetah with fixed dt=2 and subsample_max_dt=2 (008d config, seed 3) will reproduce the CIVO trigger pattern seen in Walker, confirming cross-environment generality of the trained dt_emb collapse mechanism.
experiment_data.notes: Cheetah CIVO onset@45K confirmed (ve_ratio=2.3). ve_ratio自修复但eval持续下滑(192.5@75K→61.7@105K=14% baseline), actor_entropy升至-0.7(策略退化). 分类: onset_transient_then_degraded — CIVO造成不可恢复性能损伤. Cheetah onset rate 3/4 (75%), cross-env 6/7 (86%).
